children.text: The video follows the pattern of her classic cooking video's, but the absurdity shines through in all aspects. Within the first ten seconds, Nara zooms in on herself instead of the recipe she is preparing. Her outfit looks to be off a runway rather than something a mom of four young children would wear. This allows Nara to send two decisive messages right as the video begins. First, there is a level of absurdity to the idealistic life she is portraying. Second, claims that she is a tradwife or lacking true self-expression cannot be taken seriously while she wears a Selezza London dress worth $1,164.

As with all her cooking videos, the stated reason for showcasing the recipe is simple; the kids asked. In this particular script, she states she would “make them some really quick” which is clearly sarcasm. However, much of the audience refuses to accept this. Knowing the response could be negative, Nara moves forward with posting the video in order to draw in multiple audiences. Not only does she have her Gen Z female fans that watch for the glimpse of luxury, but she the reliable stream of haters that come from all walks of life. On top of the first two audiences, the TikTok algorithm continues to introduce people to her for the first time and interact out of confusion. Just as each part of her recipe is thought through, unique lines in her video are meant for the wide range of people she can claim as her audience.

Instead of keeping the focus on the simplicity or accessibility of recipes, Nara consistently finds recipes that are technical and reduce the amount of processed foods used. This causes a distinct shift in the specific genre of cooking videos she produces. Her content loses some relatability with the largest demographic of cooking video consumers, but a certain niche of viewers that are heavily interested in holistic health become increasingly inclined to watch. Even though her stated goal is not to villainize the processed foods widely available to Americans, there is an underlying tone of superiority that comes with the “health” food genre which fits well with the luxury housewife aesthetic.

Almost four years into Nara Smith’s TikTok career she follows a similar pattern of video uploads. She switches between three to four main formats with varying levels of engagement. Before this video was posted, her most recent videos had underperformed based on past expectations. This likely provided the motivation for her to post a video where her technical cooking skills, humor, and lifestyle were all highlighted at once. Based on the production of the video, it is likely that Nara pre-filmed it long before it went up and was waiting for the timing to provide the greatest benefit to her through bringing back millions of viewers.
